desiredAction: Approve design work for a measured twelve-month extension.
centralTakeaway: The pilot created a credible local operating base, but the next phase must test affordability and outcomes.
narrativeArc: The pilot combined infrastructure with local capacity.
Early use is promising but not yet an outcome.
A measured extension can resolve the most important unknowns.

slides.headline: Local capacity made connectivity usable
slides.primaryMessage: Infrastructure and local capability were designed together.

slides.headline: The pilot joined access, skills, device support, and governance
slides.primaryMessage: Four connected activities formed one operating model.

slides.headline: 120 residents completed introductory network training
slides.primaryMessage: The pilot built a broad introductory cohort.

slides.headline: 18 advanced graduates formed the smaller maintenance pathway
slides.primaryMessage: Advanced capability was intentionally narrower than introductory reach.
slides.nextLink: Show how the hubs were used.

slides.headline: The two hubs recorded 4,800 visits in six months
slides.primaryMessage: Use was substantial enough to justify deeper outcome measurement.

slides.headline: Education was the most frequently reported use
slides.primaryMessage: Reported use spanned education, services, and income-related activity.

slides.headline: Early use is promising, but it is not yet a verified outcome
slides.primaryMessage: The pilot lacks long-term and comparative evidence.

slides.headline: Affordability and device access remain the largest practical gaps
slides.primaryMessage: Access alone does not remove participation barriers.
slides.previousLink: Move from evidence limits to programme gaps.

slides.headline: The next phase should strengthen operations, affordability, and evidence
slides.primaryMessage: Three coordinated workstreams address the known gaps.

slides.headline: A twelve-month extension can answer the questions the pilot could not
slides.primaryMessage: The extension pairs delivery with measurement.

slides.headline: Approve design work for a measured twelve-month extension
slides.primaryMessage: Proceed to detailed design, safeguards, costing, and measurement.
